text: Border defense fortress, independent power, local targeting. The depot blackout bought us this approach, but it did not silence these guns. No patrol feed to follow now. Just sight lines and bad intentions. There's a service road beneath the western gun deck. Look where those guns are pointed, inward. They built a wall around people and called it protection. There are homes beyond that concrete. Keep the fighting on this side. We're opening a crossing, not giving them another fire. One signal ahead. Close. Steady. Someone is holding their ground under all that interference. Let me bring them through. This is Surya Prime. Stay below the gun deck. I can shelter the gate road, but you'll have to reach me. We came from the depot, five of us. Hold your position, Surya. We'll get to you together. Order Commander Voss. This crossing is closed. Return to your assigned district. You will not receive another warning. Five years of warnings. Five years of people waiting on opposite sides of that wall. I have heard enough. Fortress vents are superheated. A laser curtain guards the inner approach. Reach Surya first, then advance toward the command arena. I'll find the gaps between their searchlights. When we reach that laser curtain, follow my lead. One problem at a time. No one crosses alone. Surya, keep that light burning. Squad, move.
